document_api_meta.title: Approve Return
document_api_meta.env_desc: Use this API to approve a buyer's return request. The exact effect depends on the return type and return status. Before calling this API, make sure the return is still awaiting a seller action that matches the decision you are sending.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: idempotency_key
request_query_param.desc: A unique value generated by the client that the server uses to recognize repeated requests. Reuse the same key when retrying the same request. If omitted, the server generates a key for that call. You may use a UUID or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Maximum length: 255 characters.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: decision
request_body_param.desc:
Seller's decision for the return request, available values:
- `APPROVE_REFUND`: seller approve a refund-only request
- `APPROVE_RETURN`: seller approve the initial return-and-refund request
- `APPROVE_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`: seller approve return-and-refund request after the buyer has already shipped or handed over the item.
- `APPROVE_REPLACEMENT`: seller approve replacement request
- `ISSUE_REPLACEMENT_REFUND`: seller decline the replacement request and directly refund the buyer instead.
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`: seller offers a partial refund amount to the buyer without requiring the item(s) to be returned.
- `DIRECT_REFUND`: seller issues a returnless refund, meaning the buyer receives a full refund and keeps the item

request_body_param.name: buyer_keep_item
request_body_param.desc: **Optional**. Use this field only when decision is set to `APPROVE_RETURN`. If set to `true`, the seller issues a returnless refund, which means the buyer receives a full refund and keeps the item. If set to `false` or omitted, the seller approves the return-and-refund flow and the buyer returns the item.

request_body_param.name: partial_refund
request_body_param.desc: **Required** when `decision` is set to `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`. When `partial_refund` is provided, both `amount` and `currency` are required. Omit this field for all other decisions.

request_body_param.name: ^currency
request_body_param.desc: Refund currency must match the currency of the current return request.

request_body_param.name: ^amount
request_body_param.desc: The partial refund amount seller would like to offer to the buyer

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

sample_code.value:
// For more details about the SDK, refer to the documentation:
// https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67c83e0799a75104986ae498
func returnRefund202309ApproveReturnPost() {
    configuration := apis.NewConfiguration()
    configuration.AddAppInfo(appKey, appSecret)
    apiClient := apis.NewAPIClient(configuration)
    request := apiClient.ReturnRefundV202309API.ReturnRefund202309ReturnsReturnIdApprovePost(context.Background(), "4035319218955782461")
    request = request.XTtsAccessToken("your access token")
    request = request.ContentType("application/json")
    request = request.IdempotencyKey("40b456b1-78e7-412d-9fe6-82181496e1bd")
    request = request.ShopCipher("your shop cipher")
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody := returnRefund_v202309.NewReturnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody()
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody.SetDecision("APPROVE_REFUND")
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody.SetBuyerKeepItem(true)
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBodyPartialRefund := returnRefund_v202309.NewReturnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBodyPartialRefund()
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBodyPartialRefund.SetCurrency("IDR")
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBodyPartialRefund.SetAmount("10")
    returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody.SetPartialRefund(*returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBodyPartialRefund)
    request = request.ReturnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody(*returnRefund202309ApproveReturnRequestBody)
    resp, httpResp, err := request.Execute()
    if err != nil || httpResp.StatusCode != 200 {
        fmt.Printf("productsRequest err:%v resbody:%s", err, httpResp.Body)
        return
    }
    if resp == nil {
        fmt.Printf("response is nil")
        return
    }
    if resp.GetCode()!= 0 {
        fmt.Printf("response business is error, errorCode:%d errorMessage:%s", resp.GetCode(), resp.GetMessage())
        return
    }
    respDataJson, _ := json.MarshalIndent(resp.GetData(), "", "  ")
    fmt.Println("response data:", string(respDataJson))
    return
}
